name: imsg-mcp
description: iMessage / SMS MCP for macOS — read, search, send, attach.
long_description: Read chat.db, send iMessage/SMS via AppleScript with auto-fallback, search messages with fuzzy + literal modes, fetch attachments (HEIC→PNG auto-conversion), browse via MCP Resources, run analytics, and search/list/resolve contacts — all from your Mac. End-user data never leaves the device unless you configure a cloud media-interpretation provider below.

imsg_db_path.title: iMessage chat.db path
imsg_db_path.description: Override the default ~/Library/Messages/chat.db. Leave empty for the default.

contacts_db_path.title: AddressBook DB path
contacts_db_path.description: Override the default AddressBook-v22.abcddb path. Leave empty for the default (both the local and all iCloud source Address Books are loaded automatically).

transcribe_provider.title: Media-interpretation provider (optional)
transcribe_provider.description: For AI voice-note transcription & image descriptions when Apple/local tools aren't available. One of: openai, groq, openrouter. Leave empty to stay fully on-device.

transcribe_api_key.title: Provider API key (optional)
transcribe_api_key.description: API key for the provider above. Stored securely by Claude Desktop; only used if a provider is set. Leave empty to keep all media on-device.

transcribe_model.title: Transcription model (optional)
transcribe_model.description: Override the default model (e.g. whisper-1, whisper-large-v3). Leave empty for the provider default.
